name: Feb 2024 cold snap (replay)
capacityNote: Hypothetical: capacity set 3 MMcf/day below this scenario's peak-day demand. Daily limit per gas day; within-day swings are covered by linepack and storage (assumed).
source: Hourly temperatures: routine hourly observations at ANCHORAGE TED STEVENS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (PANC), IEM ASOS archive (data/raw/asos_panc_feb2024.csv), 2024-01-31 to 2024-02-03. Window: coldest 72 h (12:00 day 1 to 12:00 day 4) between 2024-01-25 and 2024-02-10, chosen from ACIS StnData daily max/min (data/raw/acis_panc_2024-01_2024-02.json). systemMMcfh = (a + b × ACIS daily HDD) × demand_shape, from data/system_fit.json; daily HDD 73, 74, 77, 75.

forecastRuns.label: sourced
forecastRuns.source: IEM MOS archive, PANC, NBS run 2024-01-30T07Z (data/raw/iem_mos_nbs_panc_feb2024.json), with NBE beyond its range (data/raw/iem_mos_nbe_panc_feb2024.json). Hourly values: the run's hourly temperatures (3-hourly tmp, 12-hourly beyond NBS), interpolated linearly; spread from tsd.
